# Barlow attribution

Krab self-hosts the Barlow typeface (latin subset, weights 400, 500, 600 and 700) from the [`@fontsource/barlow` 5.3.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/barlow/v/5.3.0) package. Vite emits the font files into the build. Barlow is designed by Jeremy Tribby and published by [the Barlow Project](https://github.com/jpt/barlow).

Copyright 2017 The Barlow Project Authors (https://github.com/jpt/barlow).

The font software is licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1. The full licence ships with the site at `static/licenses/barlow-OFL.txt`, copied unchanged from the package's `LICENSE` file, and is available with a FAQ at https://openfontlicense.org.
